name: Abs

x.description: Input tensor of any shape (1D-4D seen in workloads). Supports float32, float16, bfloat16.

y.description: Output tensor, same shape and dtype as input x.

description:
Abs: Computes the absolute value of each element.

torch.abs = abs(input, *, out=None) -> Tensor

out_i = |input_i|

Args:
    input (Tensor): the input tensor.

Keyword args:
    out (Tensor, optional): the output tensor.

Example:
    >>> torch.abs(torch.tensor([-1, -2, 3]))
    tensor([1, 2, 3])

Returns: Tensor, same shape as input.
